__exploit_modes_help__: Omit exploit_modes for a single-mode fleet (uses 'mode' + the top-level budget). To run independent per-mode budget tracks, list each mode with its own overrides; keys omitted fall back to the top-level values. Each mode is its OWN bucket (accrual/cap), so per-mode accrual_usd_per_month + bucket_cap_usd should sum to your intended total. Explore benchmarks all modes and is funded from the first (primary) mode. Example:
offer_query: reliability>0.95 num_gpus=1 gpu_ram>=8 cuda_vers>=12.0 rentable=true inet_down>100 disk_space>=30 dph_total<0.40
